title: Development Environment Mapping
description: One workstation's local checkout and toolchain locations. This document is machine-specific and is never committed: it lives at .local/environment.json, and the committed artifacts are this schema and the example beside it. Paths are development defaults, not deployment contracts — production provisioning derives nothing from them. Secrets never appear here; they come from an external secret facility.

checkouts.description: Absolute path to each integration's local checkout. Every property is optional because a given workflow needs only the integrations it drives, but the roster is closed so a misspelled integration fails validation instead of silently going missing.

toolchains.description: Absolute paths to third-party toolchains that are not HoloBike software and therefore have no integration directory under Spec/Stack. Only toolchains that must be located by path appear here; tools resolved from PATH (compilers, CMake, Ninja) are validated by preflight rather than declared.

absolutePath.description: An absolute path. Preflight normalizes and validates it before any build is invoked.
